notSetUpMessage: Google Meet integration isn't set up for this institute. Connect a Google Workspace account under Settings → Live Session → Google Meet Integration, or paste a meeting link in the Live Class Link field below.
linkCreatedOnAccount: A Google Meet link is created on this account.
anyoneWithLinkJoins: Anyone with the link joins (no knocking) — best for learners.
guestsMustKnock: Guests must knock and the host admits each one.
autoRecordingOn: Auto-recording is ON — a teacher signed into the institute’s Workspace must be present.
manageJoinAccessAndRecording: Manage join-access and recording per account under Settings → Live Session → Google Meet Integration.
